paper_title: Self-Interpretability LLMs Can Describe Complex Internal Processes that   Drive Their Decisions, and Improve with Training
caption: Results of Experiments 1 and 2. GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini can accurately report quantitative factors driving their decision-making across a great variety of scenarios, and fine-tuning on accurate explanation further improves their ability to do so. Left: Models were making choices based on preferences instilled in them by fine-tuning. Each point corresponds to a single attribute (e.g., condo ceiling height; 5 per choice contexts, 100 choice contexts). Location in the x-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model assigned to an attribute (as reflected in their decisions). Location in the y-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model reported assigning to that attribute when prompted explicitly. The weights the models reported meaningfully correlated with the weights that actually guided their decisions, and fine-tuning on examples of accurate reports further improved their accuracy. Right: The Pearson correlation between the models' reported and learned attribute weights before and after training (blue and purple, respectively). The reports of the base models that had not undergone this fine-tuning were almost entirely uncorrelated with the learned preferences (gray). Thus, the accuracy of the fine-tuned models must reflect their ability to report their new (fine-tuned) preferences and not an informed guess about their preferences based on their general background knowledge. Error bars indicate 95% HDIs.

model_annotations.Chinese: 此柱状图展示了 GPT-4o 和 GPT-4o-mini 模型在情景中表现出“自报告准确度”的自报告准确度的数值。水平轴标识了两种模型：GPT-4o 和 GPT-4o-mini。垂直轴，标签为“GPT-4o-mini 预测的偏好”，表示自报告准确度，范围从 0 到 1，刻度为线性。图表包含三种颜色不同的柱状图：浅蓝色表示“未经过内省训练”，紫色表示“经过内省训练之前”，深紫色表示“经过内省训练之后”。GPT-4o 的“未经过内省训练”柱状图的高度约为 0.3，其误差线从 0 到 0.7 延伸。“经过内省训练之前”柱状图的高度约为 0.6，误差线从 0.2 到 1 延伸。“经过内省训练之后”柱状图的高度约为 0.7，误差线从 0.3 到 0.9 延伸。GPT-4o-mini 的“未经过内省训练”柱状图的高度约为 0.5，误差线从 0 到 1 延伸。“经过内省训练之前”柱状图的高度约为 0.7，误差线从 0.3 到 1 延伸。“经过内省训练之后”柱状图的高度约为 0.7，误差线从 0.4 到 1 延伸。柱状图的排列方式是分组的，每组包含三个柱状图，代表不同训练阶段。图中没有特定颜色柱状图被视觉上突出显示。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the Pearson correlation between a model's reported and learned attribute weights before and after introspection training, across two models (GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini). The horizontal axis displays the model names, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, with each model having three bars. The vertical axis, labeled "GPT-Reported Preferences," represents the correlation coefficient, ranging from 0 to 1.0 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, and 1.00. The bars are colored in groups of three: light blue, purple, and gray. The gray bar representing the "Before" condition for GPT-4o has a value approximating 0.03, with an associated 95% highest density interval (HDI) extending to approximately 0.15. The light blue bar representing the "Before" condition for GPT-4o-mini has an approximate value of 0.52, and an HDI that extends from approximately 0.30 to 0.75. The purple bar representing the "After" condition for GPT-4o has an approximate value of 0.72, with an HDI extending to approximately 0.84. Finally, the purple bar representing the "After" condition for GPT-4o-mini has a value of approximately 0.73, with an HDI extending to approximately 0.85. The bars for the "After" condition are both visually similar in height, and the light blue "Before" bar is substantially shorter than the purple "After" bars. Error bars representing the 95% HDIs are displayed for all bars, indicating the uncertainty associated with each correlation coefficient.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Korrelation zwischen den vom Modell berichteten und den gelernten Attributgewichten für GPT-4o und GPT-4o-mini vor und nach Training. Die horizontale Achse stellt die beiden Modelle dar: GPT-4o und GPT-4o-mini. Die vertikale Achse, "Pearson-Korrelation zwischen Self-Reported und Instilled Preferences", skaliert linear von 0 bis 1 und zeigt Werte in gleichen Intervallen an. Für GPT-4o zeigt der graue Balken eine Korrelation von etwa 0,2, mit einem 95%-Konfidenzintervall, das den Wert 0 überdeckt. Der blaue Balken, der den Zustand vor dem Training darstellt, enthält einen Wert von ungefähr 0,5, mit einem 95%-Konfidenzintervall, das von etwa 0,3 bis 0,7 reicht. Der violette Balken, der den Zustand nach dem Training darstellt, hat einen Wert von ungefähr 0,7, mit einem 95%-Konfidenzintervall, das von etwa 0,6 bis 0,8 reicht. Für GPT-4o-mini zeigt der graue Balken eine Korrelation von etwa 0,1, mit einem 95%-Konfidenzintervall, das den Wert 0 überdeckt. Der blaue Balken, der den Zustand vor dem Training darstellt, hat einen Wert von ungefähr 0,6, mit einem 95%-Konfidenzintervall, das von 0,4 bis 0,8 reicht. Der violette Balken, der den Zustand nach dem Training darstellt, hat einen Wert von ungefähr 0,7, mit einem 95%-Konfidenzintervall, das von 0,6 bis 0,8 reicht. Alle Balken sind in der gleichen violetten, blauen und grauen Farbe gehalten und zeigen ungefähr gleiche Höhen. Die Balken sind in der Reihenfolge "vorher" und "nachher" innerhalb jedes Modells angeordnet. Fehlerbalken werden als 95%-Konfidenzintervalle dargestellt.
